headwords: lời chào cao hơn mâm cỗ

flags.why: The word belongs to North Central Vietnamese, so the Northern tag incorrectly suggests use in northern Vietnam ([Wiktionary](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/lớp_tớp)).
The adverb likewise belongs to North Central Vietnamese rather than both Northern and Central Vietnamese ([Wiktionary](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/lớp_tớp)).
'Lỡ đường' means being unable to continue a journey, whereas losing one's way is 'lạc đường'.
flags.fix: to be stranded or held up on a journey
